fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last checkpoint ID from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The checkpoint identifier, which can be referenced in the API endpoints.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the checkpoint was created.

fields.name: fineTunedModelCheckpoint
fields.description: The name of the fine-tuned checkpoint model that is created.

fields.name: stepNumber
fields.description: The step number that the checkpoint was created at.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Metrics at the step number during the fine-tuning job.

fields.name: fineTuningJobId
fields.description: The name of the fine-tuning job that this checkpoint was created from.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always "fine_tuning.job.checkpoint".
